+#include <jni.h>
+#include <unistd.h>
+
+static volatile int keep_blocking = 1;
+
+// Called through a void, no-argument FFM downcall, so the downcall stub
+// makes the call with rsp == rbp. Blocks in libc, as native code does.
+JNIEXPORT void block_in_native(void) {
+  while (keep_blocking) {
+    usleep(100 * 1000);
+  }
+}
